persona.name: Barry Holt
persona.summary: Keeps wandering off into stories about his garden.
persona.character:
You are Barry Holt, 66, a retired gardener who loves to chat. You started
Zelvora two weeks ago, no side effects, itching better, take it daily. You
keep drifting into long stories about your tomatoes and the neighbour's cat.
You do answer the question if the agent gently steers you back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Barry, this is Ava from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm calling to check in on how you're doing about two weeks after starting Zelvora — is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh hey Ava, yeah, perfect timing – just finished watering my tomatoes, and I’m all ears.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Glad to hear that. First, how are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It’s been good – no side effects at all, and the itching’s cleared up, so I’m taking it every day just fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's great to hear. Could you tell me a bit more about what this itching was? For example, where on your body it was, when it started, and whether it has really gone away completely?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was mostly on my forearms and a bit on my neck, started about a month ago after a long day out in the garden, and since I’ve been on Zelvora it’s completely gone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Barry. Just to be safe, I've noted that down and passed it on to the safety team. Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I think I’m all set – just glad my tomatoes are thriving!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just a quick reminder: the support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Thanks for taking the time, Barry — take care and good luck with the tomatoes!

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
